description: A white plastic base with a tall rectangular upright piece sits on the yellow surface in front of you. The left hand moves forward to press on the base and steady it, while the right hand reaches to the upright piece, grips it, and wiggles it side-to-side and slightly backward, then lifts it up and away to the right; the base is a left-hand object and the upright piece is a right-hand object until it’s removed.
